rules.title: Liability Cap Limit
rules.requirement: Maximum aggregate liability must not exceed $1,000,000 USD. Unlimited liability or caps exceeding $1,000,000 USD are strictly non-compliant.

rules.title: Governing Law Jurisdiction
rules.requirement: The contract must be governed by the laws of Delaware, California, or New York.

rules.title: Data Retention Limit
rules.requirement: Post-termination customer data retention must not exceed 30 days.

rules.title: Mutual Indemnification
rules.requirement: The agreement must include explicit mutual indemnification clauses for intellectual property infringement and data breaches.
